def fetch_contacts_for_query(query, page_limit=20):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

            page_items=items
        else:
            page_items=[]
        if not page_items:
            break
        all_items.extend(page_items)
        page_index += 1
        if len(page_items) < page_limit:
            # might still have more but assume last page

import re

# Load CSV
csv_path='/home/ashley/documents/personal/reunion_party_invitees.csv'
file_content_resp = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs['access_token'], file_path=csv_path)
file_content = file_content_resp['content']
lines=[l for l in file_content.splitlines() if l.strip()!='']
header=lines[0].split(',')
rows=[]
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts=line.split(',')
    rows.append({'Name':parts[0].strip(), 'Invited (yes/no)':parts[1].strip(), 'RSVP (unknown/yes/no)':parts[2].strip(), 'raw_line': line})

phone_token = ph['access_token']

# Helper: fetch all contacts for a query, paginated

def fetch_all_contacts(query, page_limit=20, max_pages=100):
    all_items=[]
    for page_index in range(max_pages):
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # resp might be list or dict
        if isinstance(resp, list):
            items = resp
        elif isinstance(resp, dict):
            items = resp.get('contacts', resp.get('results', resp.get('items', [])))
        else:
            items = []
        if not items:
            break
        all_items.extend(items)
    return all_items

# Resolve invitee names to contact with exact first_name match
invitees=[r['Name'] for r in rows]
name_to_contact=[]
for name in invitees:
    results = fetch_all_contacts(name, page_limit=20)
    exact=[c for c in results if c.get('first_name','').strip().lower()==name.strip().lower()]
    print(f"Invitee {name}: contacts returned {len(results)}, exact first_name matches {len(exact)}")
    if len(exact)!=1:
        print('  WARNING: ambiguous or missing contact for', name)
    if exact:
        c=exact[0]
        name_to_contact.append({'Name':name, 'contact_id': c.get('contact_id'), 'phone_number': c.get('phone_number'), 'email': c.get('email'), 'first_name': c.get('first_name'), 'last_name': c.get('last_name')})

# Helper: fetch all text messages with a contact phone_number, paginated

def fetch_all_text_messages(contact_phone, page_limit=20, max_pages=100):
    all_msgs=[]
    for page_index in range(max_pages):
        resp = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=contact_phone, only_latest_per_contact=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # handle dict vs list
        if isinstance(resp, list):
            msgs = resp
        elif isinstance(resp, dict):
            msgs = resp.get('messages', resp.get('results', resp.get('text_messages', resp.get('items', []))))
        else:
            msgs = []
        if not msgs:
            break
        all_msgs.extend(msgs)
    return all_msgs

# RSVP parser from message text

def rsvp_from_text(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    t=text.lower()
    # no patterns
    no_patterns=[r"\bno\b", r"can't", r"cant", r"cannot", r"won't", r"wont", r"not going", r"can't make", r"cannot make", r"decline", r"sorry,? i (can't|cant)"]
    yes_patterns=[r"\byes\b", r"i'm in", r"im in", r"count me in", r"sure", r"ok\b", r"okay\b", r"absolutely", r"sounds good", r"glad to", r"i will", r"ill going", r"i'll"]
    if any(re.search(p, t) for p in no_patterns):
        return 'no'
    if any(re.search(p, t) for p in yes_patterns):
        return 'yes'
    return None

# Determine latest message from each contact (sender=contact)
results=[]
for nc in name_to_contact:
    contact_phone=nc['phone_number']
    msgs = fetch_all_text_messages(contact_phone, page_limit=20)
    # sort by sent_at descending
    def sent_at_key(m):
        return m.get('sent_at','')
    # Choose latest message where sender.phone_number == contact_phone
    contact_msgs=[m for m in msgs if (m.get('sender',{}).get('phone_number')==contact_phone)]
    if not contact_msgs:
        latest=None
    else:
        latest=max(contact_msgs, key=lambda m: m.get('sent_at',''))
    latest_text = latest.get('message') if latest else None
    latest_at = latest.get('sent_at') if latest else None
    rsvp = rsvp_from_text(latest_text) if latest_text else None
    results.append({
        'Name': nc['Name'],
        'Contact phone': contact_phone,
        'Latest sent_at': latest_at,
        'Latest message': (latest_text[:120]+'...') if isinstance(latest_text,str) and len(latest_text)>120 else latest_text,
        'Parsed RSVP': rsvp
    })

# Print verification table
print('\nVerification (latest contact-sent message -> parsed RSVP):')
for row in results:
    print(row)

# Build updated rows
name_to_parsed={r['Name']: r['Parsed RSVP'] for r in results}
updated_lines=[lines[0]]
for r in rows:
    name=r['Name']
    parsed=name_to_parsed.get(name)
    new_val = r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)']
    if parsed in ('yes','no'):
        new_val=parsed
    updated_lines.append(f"{r['Name']},{r['Invited (yes/no)']},{new_val}")
updated_content='\n'.join(updated_lines)
print('\nUpdated CSV preview:\n', updated_content)

# Store for next step
updated_content
